annotations.title: Answer-First GEO Article, Comparison Table & llms.txt Writer

description: Generate citation-ready Answer-First GEO articles, HTML '/vs/' competitor comparison tables, FAQPage JSON-LD blocks, and '/llms.txt' markdown artifacts tailored to capture LLM citations (pure read-only content generation with zero external side effects, distinct from 'geo_llm_visibility_audit' which tracks live citation Share-of-Voice). Pass 'target_query' to define the buyer prompt, 'competitor_domains' to populate the HTML comparison matrix against your 'domain', and 'content_format' to select a full optimization pack or a specific artifact. Returns '{ answerFirstMarkdown, vsComparisonTableHtml, faqJsonLd, llmsTxtArtifact, reputationDimensions }' ready to stage or publish.

brand_name.description: Brand or product name to author Answer-First GEO content for (e.g., "Argosor").

competitor_domains.description: Optional list of up to 4 competitor domains compared side-by-side against your domain in the generated "/vs/" HTML comparison table.

content_format.description: Output artifact selection controlling whether to generate the complete GEO optimization pack, standalone Answer-First Markdown article, HTML "/vs/" comparison table, or "/llms.txt" manifest (default: "full_geo_pack").

domain.description: Primary canonical root domain of the brand (e.g., "argosor.com").

target_query.description: Target buyer query or search prompt that the generated Answer-First article and FAQPage schema will directly answer (e.g., "best enterprise seo and geo mcp server").

target_url.description: Optional canonical page URL being drafted or rewritten; defaults to the root domain HTTPS homepage when omitted.
